summary: Iter 33 attributes/categories frontend testing. Discovered and fixed 4 blocking compile/runtime errors before UI was usable. Verified admin Attributes tab CRUD (attributes + groups) works end-to-end. Verified admin Categories tab renders with drag handles + arrows. Marketplace sidebar (3-level) and mobile drawer work. AttributeFilterPanel is correctly hidden when facets are empty (DB is post-purge with 0 products). Full seller/product/marketplace-filter end-to-end not exercised because DB has no seller account, no products, and email-verification signup is a heavy path — main agent should self-test with a seeded product.

ui_bugs.issue: Recursive JSX component <CategoryCheckTree> triggered `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded` inside @emergentbase/visual-edits babel plugin, blocking entire frontend compile (red overlay on every page). FIXED by flattening the recursive render to an iterative list with depth field.

(1) File had duplicated dangling JSX after the final `}` (lines 654-668, `...` fragments) causing syntax error. (2) `` component self-recursion also crashed visual-edits babel plugin. FIXED: truncated the trailing garbage and added a `CategoryNode → CategoryNodeInner` indirection so the recursive call goes through a different identifier.
`SlidersHorizontal` icon used in the tabs config but not imported from lucide-react → runtime `ReferenceError` → `Something went wrong` error boundary on /admin. FIXED: added the import.

`useState`/`useEffect` for attribute defs were declared AFTER the `if (!product) return <Loading/>` early-return, violating rules-of-hooks; craco/CRA reject as compile error. FIXED: moved the hooks above the early return.

action_items: Verify the 4 fixes above are acceptable (they preserve behaviour but change component shape).

Seed at least one shop + product with attributes (Electronics → Mobile Phones, Brand=Samsung, Storage=256GB) so marketplace facets, attribute filter panel, and product-detail Specifications card can be end-to-end tested. AttributeFilterPanel currently returns null because facets are empty (0 products in DB).
End-to-end test the seller flow separately: hierarchical selects (product-cat-level-0/1), AttributeFieldsEditor rendering Brand/Storage/RAM inputs, product save + reopen persistence.
Manually test HTML5 drag-and-drop in AdminCategoriesTab (Playwright DnD is unreliable; handles + arrows verified but nesting move not performed).

Depth-warning banner (cat-depth-warning) not visually verified — current tree has depth 3 which is below the trigger threshold; needs a 4th-level category to trigger. Only ran a static check (banner absent as expected).
critical_code_review_comments: The @emergentbase/visual-edits babel plugin cannot handle a JSX component that references itself. Any new recursive tree components in this project must use the CategoryNode/CategoryNodeInner indirection pattern or a flattened iterative render, otherwise the entire frontend build breaks.

AdminCategoriesTab.jsx had a pre-existing textual garbage tail (lines 654-668 duplicate JSX after end of file) — likely from a merge/paste mistake. Add a lint/pre-commit check for trailing tokens after top-level closing braces.
ProductDetail.jsx pattern of adding hooks below the early-return keeps recurring — main agent should add all new state/effects at the top of the function body.
AdminDashboard.jsx lucide imports were incomplete for the newly-referenced SlidersHorizontal — recommend an ESLint no-undef rule (currently seemingly disabled for lucide) or explicit import checks.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend now compiles. Admin flows for Attributes + Categories tabs verified. To retest properly you need a seeded shop + product with attributes so /marketplace facets and /products/{id} Specifications render. Registering a new seller through the UI hits email-verification; either use API-only seeding as admin, or bypass verification in seed. Playwright HTML5 drag-and-drop between category rows is flaky — verify manually or via dispatched dragstart/drop events.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the compile blockage was the visual-edits babel plugin (@emergentbase/visual-edits/babel-plugin) recursing indefinitely when a React functional component contains a JSX self-reference. Reproduced with `NODE_ENV=development npx @babel/core transform with the plugin — throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded`. Removing the self-reference (either flattening or indirecting via a wrapper component) unblocks compilation. Additional independent blockers (AdminCategoriesTab garbage tail, missing SlidersHorizontal import, hooks below early-return in ProductDetail) surfaced only after each prior fix, so they were addressed sequentially.
